fields.description: Waldorf Astoria Residences Yas is Aldar’s furnished residential development beside Yas Links on Yas Island. Three buildings accommodate apartments, one-bedroom duplexes and four-bedroom penthouses, with hospitality-style services and shared leisure facilities.

research.community: Waldorf Astoria Residences Yas · Yas Island
overview: The launch announcement credits Nordic Office Architects and KZ Design Services. Homes are furnished, with apartment and duplex layouts distinct from the larger penthouses.

The project promotes concierge and valet services alongside residents’ facilities. Housekeeping is listed as an additional paid service. The advertised Yas Links Country Club membership lasts one year from handover, with eligibility conditions; it should not be interpreted as permanent golf access.
research.locationNote: On Yas Island beside Yas Links, with the Yas Marina Circuit and waterfront forming the wider setting. Confirm the orientation of the selected home; not every residence has every advertised view.
research.priceNote: The original general fact sheet starts at AED 3.8m. This is a historical launch reference, not a current quote. Furnishing specifications and any separately charged services must be confirmed in the sales documents.
research.paymentNote: The table reproduces the original 60/40 launch dates, several of which have passed. A present purchase needs a fresh statement showing amounts already paid, outstanding instalments and any amended schedule.
research.handoverNote: FY2025 lists 2029, replacing Q4 2028 launch timing; reconfirm.
